plugins.name: narrator
plugins.description: Click ⏸︎ narrator off in the footer, or /narrator, and after each turn Claude tells you out loud what it did, in your language, with the best free voice your system has.

plugins.name: user-tools
plugins.description: A User Tools panel: pick the model and the effort with a click, switch the narrator, Remote Control and Prompt Upgrade. Its name, models and efforts are yours to change in /config.
